Subject: Renewal stitching + top-up schedule for CareBridge private offer

Sam — thanks again for the time earlier. Per our conversation, I wanted to put a short note outlining the proposed approach so procurement can route paperwork without creating a gap. High-level plan:  

- Renewal: move the existing marketplace private offer to a 12-month aligned term starting 2027-02-01.
- Top-up: immediate 35% capacity uplift starting on acceptance, billed on a pro-rated invoice tied to the private offer.
- Staging: tranche the top-up into two invoice tranches (50% now, 50% at month 7) to match your fiscal cadence.

Attached: CareBridge_SOW_v3.pdf (contains the updated usage bands + QoS SLAs) and a sample PO top-up spreadsheet.

Action items for your team: please confirm the acceptance window and the signer name for the PO. If procurement needs a different billing cadence we can adjust — the two-tranche approach is flexible.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Ben for the billing lane and Kimberly for legal/marketplace acceptance steps.

Cheers,
